about.en: TET (Tectum Emission Token) is the token of Tectum, a payments-focused blockchain project behind SoftNote, a bearer-style product for transferring bitcoin value off-chain with instant, fee-free settlement. TET is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum at 0x68A47Fe1CF42eBa4a030a10CD4D6a1031Ca3CA0a with 8 decimals, and is distinct from the separate Tectum Cash Token (TCT).
